resource_meaning: 32MiB bounds fixture-controlled cumulative payload/copy allowance, not total process RSS. External disposable guest memory/PID/wall enforcement is mandatory and separately reviewed. Sixteen counts all trace attempted invocation RPCs including Audit-to-root hops; Loader handles, setup and cleanup are separately bounded.
placement: One owned disposable native celld runtime is sufficient. Dynamic isolates and native RPC are exercised; cross-process, cross-VM and OS end-to-end proof is not claimed.
execution: NOT_RUN; parent run-slot and exact source/profile independent review required. No guest or workload launched by authoring.
